meta.pipeline_flow_en:
1. Frozen checkpoint → run_4class_gradcam.py batch inference → gradcam_results.csv (fixed probabilities)
2. Clinicians review gradcam_screening.html → mark unreadable frames → export gradcam_rejected.csv
3. apply_gradcam_screening_filter.py → match filename+split → recompute metrics (same probs)
4. This audit HTML → charts, three-line tables, anti-cheat checks, reproducible commands

audit_checks.title: Exclusion criterion is image quality only (not model correctness)
audit_checks.detail: Unique reject_reason values: ['图像质量差-胃壁层次不清']

audit_checks.title: Rejected set is not an oracle filter (misclassified-only removal)
audit_checks.detail: Among rejected frames, model was correct on 15/1355 (1.1%). An oracle cheat would reject almost only misclassified frames.

audit_checks.title: Post-screening accuracy is not ~100% (rules out keep-correct-only cheat)
audit_checks.detail: Post-screening ACC = 71.18%; oracle upper bound (keep all correct) = 100%.

audit_checks.title: Quality screening beats random removal at matched sample size
audit_checks.detail: Random removal of 1355 frames: ACC = 51.68% ± 0.43% (300 seeds); quality screening ACC = 71.18%.

audit_checks.title: Model probabilities are frozen (no re-inference or retraining)
audit_checks.detail: Metrics recomputed from existing prob_T1…prob_T4+ in gradcam_results.csv.

audit_checks.title: Clinical UI hides ground truth and predictions by default
audit_checks.detail: gradcam_screening.html uses doctorMode=true; reviewers judge wall-layer visibility only.

audit_checks.title: Every rejected frame is traceable via uid / filename in CSV
audit_checks.detail: Rejected list: 1355 rows with uid, filename, split, reject_reason, updated_at.
